title: migrate-the-state-machine-from-an-adhoc-approach
description: migrate the state machine from an adhoc approach to xstate

researchNotes: Relevant code is confined to `pi/extensions/changeflow/`. `index.ts` defines a serializable `machineDefinition`, derives an ad hoc `transitions` table from it, and transitions via `applyTransition(event, metadata)`. Persistence stores both `workflow.state` and `workflow.machineSnapshot`, but the snapshot is currently a simplified `{ value, context }` object rather than XState v5's persisted snapshot shape.

`package.json` already declares `xstate` and local `node_modules` exists. `npm ls xstate --depth=0` reports xstate@5.31.0 (package.json range is ^5.19.0). `npm run check` currently passes before any changes.

XState v5 API verified locally: `createMachine(machineDefinition)`, `createActor(machine, { snapshot })`, `actor.start()`, `actor.send({ type })`, `actor.getSnapshot().value`, and `actor.getPersistedSnapshot()` work. A persisted machine snapshot for this simple machine is shaped like `{ status: 'active', value: 'research', historyValue: {}, context: {}, children: {} }`; actor restoration via `{ snapshot: saved }` resumes at the saved state.

Behavior that must be preserved: `transition()` saves workflow JSON, appends a session entry, updates the status line; `transitionAndMaybeContinue()` queues the next agent-owned phase only after successful transitions; metadata feedback is stored in `context.latestFeedback`; Plannotator review results call the same transition path and mark review records completed; invalid events currently return `Event <EVENT> is not valid from state <STATE>.`.

README already documents the intended XState migration and sample code, but it says the ad hoc reducer exists so the extension can load without dependencies. That is no longer a blocker in this checkout because dependencies are installed and xstate import works. README's XState direction section should be updated after implementation.

Types to update carefully: `Workflow.machineSnapshot` is currently typed as `{ value: WorkflowState; context: Record<string, unknown> }`. XState's persisted snapshot type is exported as `Snapshot<unknown>` from `xstate`; it includes `status` and extra machine fields such as `value`, `historyValue`, `context`, `children`. Since `Snapshot<unknown>` doesn't expose `value` in its base union, code should read the current state from `actor.getSnapshot().value` and validate/cast it as `WorkflowState`.

Compatibility risk: persisted workflows created before the migration may have old simplified snapshots (`{ value, context }`) without `status`. XState `createActor(..., { snapshot: oldSnapshot })` expects a persisted XState snapshot and may not restore old snapshots safely. Migration should either detect old snapshots and ignore/recreate from `workflow.state`, or normalize them to XState persisted snapshots before starting the actor.

There are no test files in `pi/extensions/changeflow`; validation is currently TypeScript-only via `npm run check`/`npm run build` (both run `tsc --noEmit`). A small helper-level test harness is not present, so implementation QA should include at least `npm run check` plus manual/local Node validation of machine transition and snapshot restoration if possible.

The active workflow JSON itself currently has the legacy simplified `machineSnapshot` shape (`value: research`, `context.workflowId`). Migration needs to preserve/upgrade this active workflow when the next transition (`RESEARCH_COMPLETE`) occurs.
decisions: Research complete: identified `pi/extensions/changeflow/index.ts` as the migration target, verified xstate is installed and usable, documented current reducer/persistence behavior and compatibility risks.
User explicitly confirmed the revised high-level plan was approved.
User approved proceeding with the detailed implementation plan.

Execution order is sequential as specified in the detailed plan: update imports/types, instantiate machine, replace transition logic, initialize snapshots, update persistence, update docs, then validate.

Implemented XState-backed transition execution in `pi/extensions/changeflow/index.ts`, initialized new workflows with XState persisted snapshots, removed legacy reducer snapshot overwrites, updated README, and verified with `npm run check` plus an XState restore/transition smoke test.

QA passed: `npm run check` and `npm run build` both completed successfully in `pi/extensions/changeflow`; `git diff --check` found no whitespace errors; grep confirmed the ad hoc transitions table and legacy snapshot writes were removed; README now documents XState execution instead of a future reducer migration.
